Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs two distinct proteomics workflows: 1) An AP-MS (Affinity Purification) approach to identify the CAR interactome using LFQ/MaxQuant, and 2) A phosphoproteomics approach using SILAC, pTyr-antibody enrichment, and IMAC enrichment to analyze the signalosome. Targeted MS (PRM) was also used specifically for CD3ζ phosphorylation analysis.
